summary: Grande Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of independent non-executive director Henry Cheuk Sang Wong effective October 15, 2026, and the appointment of Leung Lau as independent non-executive director and audit committee chair effective October 16, 2026. The filing states the resignation was not due to any disagreement with the company. Lau, aged 38, receives annual compensation of HK$120,000 (approximately US$15,385), paid monthly, plus expense reimbursement. The board determined Lau meets Nasdaq and Rule 10A-3 independence standards. No related-party transactions or appointment arrangements exist. Watch for any subsequent disclosure of additional departures suggesting governance instability.
